name: grapher
title: Grapher
description: Plot 2D and 3D equations, explicit or implicit, from Raycast
author: sparkylc2

commands.name: graph
commands.title: Graph
commands.subtitle: Grapher
commands.description: Enter equations and open them in the interactive viewer

preferences.name: frameRate
preferences.title: Animation Frame Rate
preferences.description: Upper limit on frames per second while the plot moves. Lower it if motion stutters.

preferences.name: strictCalls
preferences.title: Function Calls
preferences.label: Only defined functions can be called
preferences.description: When on, a(x + 1) is an error unless a is a defined function, instead of meaning a times (x + 1).

preferences.name: hideIntersections
preferences.title: Intersections
preferences.label: Hide intersections
preferences.description: Don't look for or mark the crossings between curves.

preferences.name: slidersOnPlot
preferences.title: Sliders
preferences.label: Draw sliders on the plot
preferences.description: Show the sliders the selected line reads in the plot's corner, where the pointer can drag them.
